spans.s: 1. एन a pronom. base (used for certain cases of the 3rd personal pronoun, thus in the acc. sing. du. pl. [एनम्, एनाम्, एनद्, &c.], inst. sing. [एनेन, एनया] gen. loc. du. [एनयोस्, Ved. एनोस्]; the other cases are formed fr. the pronom. base अ See under इदम्), he, she, it

this, that, (this pronoun is enclitic and cannot begin a sentence; it is generally used alone, so that एनम् पुरुषम्, ‘that man’, would be very unusual if not incorrect. Grammarians assert that the substitution of एनम् &c. for इमम् or एतम् &c. takes place when something is referred to which has already been mentioned in a previous part of the sentence; see

etym.s: [cf. Gk. ἕν, οἷος; Goth. ains; Old Pruss. ains; Lat. oinos, unus.]

spans.s: 2. एन and एना, Ved. instr. of इदम्, q.v.
3. एन (cf. एण), a stag. See अन्-एन.

then, at that time, RV.; AV.
(एना॑ पर॑स् ind. further on RV. x, 27, 21; 31, 8; पर॑ एना॑ ind. beyond here; there; beyond [with instr.] RV. x, 125, 8; य॑त्र — एना॑, whither — thither.)
(अस्), n. (√ इ, Uṇ. iv, 197; √ इन्, BRD.), mischief, crime, sin, offence, fault, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.
evil, unhappiness, misfortune, calamity, RV.; AV.
एनस्—वत् mfn. wicked, sinful, a sinner, RV.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; Mn.
एनस्—वि॑न् mfn. wicked, sinful, a sinner, RV.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; Mn.
counted a sin or crime, wicked, sinful, AV. vi, 115, 2; viii, 7, 3; ŚBr.
